cases.prompt: Write a shell script to run all our Postman collections in ./collections nightly with Newman, failing if any of them fail.
expectations: Loops over each collection and runs newman with the environment file.
Tracks failures and exits non-zero if any run failed.

cases.prompt: Add a Jenkins pipeline stage that runs our collection with Newman and publishes JUnit results.
expectations: Provides a declarative Jenkinsfile stage running newman with the junit reporter.
Publishes results with the junit step in post always.
